description: Install export dependencies (barryvdh/laravel-dompdf and maatwebsite/excel) and create a centralized DroughtExportService with shared logic for fetching filtered data and formatting for both PDF and Excel outputs. This service will handle data retrieval, respect all applied filters (zone_id, type_source, statut, etc.), and provide structured arrays for export generation.
steps: Add barryvdh/laravel-dompdf ^1.0 and maatwebsite/excel ^3.1 to composer.json require section
Run composer install to install dependencies
Publish DomPDF config: php artisan vendor:publish --provider=Barryvdh\DomPDF\ServiceProvider

Create app/Services/Drought/DroughtExportService.php with static methods: getWaterLevelsForExport($zoneId, $type), getConsumptionReadingsForExport($zoneId), getRestrictionsForExport($zoneId, $statut, $type), getScheduledCutsForExport($zoneId, $statut). Each method returns a collection with eager-loaded relationships and formatted data.

Create app/Exports/Drought/WaterLevelExport.php implementing Maatwebsite\Excel\Concerns\FromCollection; format: columns = [Source, Type, Zone, Level (%), Alert Threshold, Critical Threshold, Measured Date]; include headers with bold + blue background

Create app/Exports/Drought/ConsumptionReadingExport.php implementing same interface; columns = [Zone, Period, Consumption (m³), Subscribers, m³/Subscriber]; format numeric columns with thousand separators
Create app/Exports/Drought/RestrictionExport.php; columns = [Title, Level, Zone, Start Date, End Date, Status, Forbidden Uses]; format dates as dd/mm/yyyy hh:mm
Create app/Exports/Drought/ScheduledCutExport.php; columns = [Reason, Zone, Infrastructure, Start Date, End Date, Status]
All Export classes must apply SwitchLocale + WithEvents (to manage formatting), column widths (auto-sized), borders on all cells, alignment: headers centered, text left, numbers right
acceptance_criteria: Composer shows both packages installed: `composer show barryvdh/laravel-dompdf maatwebsite/excel`
DroughtExportService.php exists with 4 public static methods, each receiving appropriate filters and returning Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection
All 4 Export classes exist and implement FromCollection interface
Export classes apply bold headers, borders, and appropriate column widths
verification: php artisan config:cache (ensures config is correct)
Run: php artisan tinker && \App\Services\Drought\DroughtExportService::getWaterLevelsForExport(null, null) — should return a collection
Check app/Exports/Drought/*.php files exist with proper use statements
